observations: White metal filing cabinet with four drawers.
The bottom drawer is open, showing green and yellow hanging file folders.
The cabinet has recessed black handles on each drawer.
The item is placed outdoors on a red carpet runner in front of an industrial-style building.
There is a watermark text 'DAVID GLOBAL FURNITURE' across the middle of the image.
The photo appears to be a promotional or catalog image rather than a photo of a specific used item in a home or office setting.

claims.claim: High Quality / extremely strong and durable
claims.evidence: Material strength and build quality cannot be determined from a photo.
Origin of manufacture is not visible on the item.

risks.if_unproven: as having stiff or damaged runners

risks.risk: Missing keys or non-functional locking mechanism
risks.proof: A photo of the keys and a video demonstrating the lock securing all drawers.
risks.if_unproven: as having no keys and an unlocked/unsecured state

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage (dents, scratches, or rust) hidden by low resolution or stock photo
risks.proof: High-resolution close-up photos of all exterior panels (sides, top, and back).

proof_requests: Video of all drawers opening and closing smoothly.
Photo of the keys and the lock mechanism.
Real-world photos of the actual unit in its current location to verify it matches the promotional image.
Photos of the side and back panels.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standard 4-drawer metal filing cabinet. Since the 'brand new' claim is unverified and the photo may be a stock image, it is priced at the worst-case scenario for a used unit of this type.
